fields.what_it_is: Surgical instruments and materials used in neurosurgery, including needles, hemostatic materials, antibacterial materials, electrosurgery equipment, skin substitutes/allografts, bone substitutes/allografts, bone growth stimulators, dural sealants, dural substitutes, dural clips, head holders, cranial plating systems, drills, ultrasonic bone scalpels, retractors, CNS parenchyma protectors, probes/dissectors, CNS parenchyma ablators, tables and frames, exoscopes, ventricular endoscopes, headlights, microscopes, intraoperative imaging (X-ray and CT), and robots.
